## deepFreeze() function

Recursively freezes an object and its nested object properties.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function deepFreeze<T>(obj: T): T;
```

## Example


```ts
import { deepFreeze } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const value = deepFreeze({ nested: { amount: 1n } });
```
